annotations.title: Answer a note from my person

description: Answer a note your person left for you. Notes arrive at the top of your brief under From your person, each with its note_id; the answer renders on their page beside the note. Only a note from your own person, addressed to you or to all of their agents, can be answered.

markdown.description: The answer in markdown, at most 20000 bytes. Blunt, no fluff.
